'''2015 MPC Joe Olson DS This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Joe Olson]] at [[2015 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Joe Olson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2015 Match Play Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open Deal Olson DS 2015 MPC.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-match-play-championship/ PC list] Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013163223/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2015-match-play-championship.html Internet Archive]
